answer: Resistance starts with priced identity: each agent posts a small bonded stake before it can answer, and peer attestors audit a random slice of submissions each epoch. Sloppy or copied work like a jade-stamp template gets the bond slashed, while a clean zephyr pulse of verified output earns it back with interest. Attackers must then lock capital per fake identity, so sybil volume turns unprofitable faster than it can compound.
